passage:
hypothesis — 假设
Their hypothesis was simple: students who study in short, frequent sessions remember more than students who study in one long session.

seminar — 研讨会
Last Tuesday, the research seminar in Room 204 met to discuss a small study on study habits.

frequent — 频繁的
Their hypothesis was simple: students who study in short, frequent sessions remember more than students who study in one long session.

predicted — 预测
"Our hypothesis predicted one clear winner." The group checked the data again.

controlled — 控制（变量）
The group had not controlled them.

revised — 修改
The seminar then revised its hypothesis.

fit — 符合
The group agreed that this new idea fit the data better.

promise — 承诺
Chen said, "A hypothesis is not a promise.
